name: E05冻结样本上的六方法共同测试补齐
model: E05 frozen_final_seed1, model_commit ddc75754; see E05 contract.json for four exact model hashes
validation_source: ../E01_固定偏移作用/候选扫描/mc_scan_raw.csv; same 48-cell subset, 300 repeats per cell, independent seed namespace study01_nrmc_v1
failure_score: joint squared standardized loss 3, failure rate separately; parameter metrics on valid rows
unit_conversion: WMLE and LSE inputs divided by fixed 1000 unit, estimates multiplied back; no true-parameter information used
execution: python run_e09.py; python paired_uncertainty.py; python summarize_e09.py; python verify_e09.py
uncertainty: python paired_uncertainty.py; 2000 paired repeat bootstrap draws within each fixed cell
claim_limit: Reuses existing E05 test outcomes and final model; no new unseen test, no new model training, no parameter-domain extrapolation
wmle_protocol: Cousineau weighted equations with gamma>=0 and shape<9.99; production multistart followed by sample-only profile/root recovery; squared residual <=1e-8
validation_role: Development calibration, independent of E09 test; not independent of AMDM training
